name: Hungary
summary: Descendants, spouse and parents are guaranteed a third of their intestate share, as a money claim. A foreign resident can choose the law of their nationality (EU Succession Regulation art. 22). Hungary has a statutory fiduciary management contract in place of a trust, and private foundations are allowed.
reserved_share: Descendants, spouse and parents: one third of the share they would take on intestacy (Civil Code, Act V of 2013, reserved-share rules in Book 7; where a spouse has intestate usufruct the share takes the form of a limited usufruct). A money claim against the heirs, limitation five years. Testamentary freedom is stated in s. 7:10.
foreign_law_note: EU Succession Regulation: the law of the last habitual residence applies by default (art. 21), but a resident foreign national may choose the law of their nationality (art. 22).
trust_note: Hungary is not in the HCCH table for the 1985 Trusts Convention. The Civil Code has a contractual fiduciary asset management regime (bizalmi vagyonkezelés, Book 6) and private foundations (magánalapítvány); a 2019 amendment added an asset-management foundation form with a HUF 600 million minimum capital per commentary.
open_questions: Section numbers for the fiduciary regime and private foundations come from secondary commentary, not the Civil Code text.
The 2019 asset management foundation and its HUF 600 million minimum are from a law-firm summary; tax treatment not sourced.

sources.title: HCCH status table: Convention of 1 July 1985 on the Law Applicable to Trusts and on their Recognition
